topics.title: Classification of Living Things
subtopics: Classification of living things into kingdoms: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia
Differences between plants and animals
The Binomial system of nomenclature

State the differences between plants and animals

topics.title: Cell as a Living Unit

Comparison of plant and animal cells

Osmosis: Definition, osmotic pressure, turgidity, plasmolysis and importance

Digestive enzymes: Classes, characteristics and functions

Identify various modes of heterotrophic nutrition
Explain the role of enzymes in chemical digestion

topics.title: Transport System

Trace the path of blood through the mammalian heart
